rawContent: What took the media so long to report something the rest of us knew about during @BernieSanders campaign, you can't have that environment unless he approved of it, and silence is approval. #MeToo #DemsTakeTheHouse today and the last thing we need is #independent Sanders again.
We can't pick and choose. #BelieveSurvivors male and female, icons or not, all survivor stories must be heard. #MeToo
